plan.name: Check conformance batches at once
plan.summary: conformance.Check checks its step batches, and checkTried its state batches, several at a time instead of one after another, since the batches don't depend on each other and most of each TLC run is starting its JVM: as many at once as runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) says when Check runs, which is one per CPU unless it's been changed. Because tlc.Runner.Check writes Invariant.cfg into the directory it's given, each batch runs in a directory of its own inside dir, such as dir/steps-3 or dir/tried-2, holding copies, not links, of every .tla file directly in dir (TLC's container sees only that directory) beside the batch's module, Invariant_Conformance or Invariant_Tried, written as now; the starting states are still checked first, in dir itself. The result is what checking the batches in order gives now, whichever finishes first: the earliest batch in that order that doesn't pass decides it, whether with a step the model doesn't allow, an untried step, a run TLC couldn't finish or an error from the runner, and once a batch fails, the batches after it needn't start and those of them running may be stopped through their context, but every batch before it runs to its end, and Check returns only after every batch it started has returned. So that a stand-in can take TLC's place in tests, Check's runner parameter becomes a conformance.Runner, an interface with tlc.Runner's one method, Check(ctx context.Context, dir, module string, cfg tlc.Config) (tlc.Result, error), which tlc.Runner already has, so verify's call and Check's other parameters and results stay as they are. What's checked, each batch's module and config, and the receipt stay the same, and since this changes the trusted base, a person merges it.

tests.name: TestStepBatchesRunAtOnceEachInADirectoryOfItsOwn
tests.says: With Go using three CPUs, Check checks five step batches with more than one running at once and never more than three, each in a directory of its own inside dir that holds the model's modules as files; every step is checked exactly once, and a run whose every step is a Next step passes with the same counts as now.

tests.name: TestStateBatchesRunAtOnceEachInADirectoryOfItsOwn
tests.says: checkTried does the same with its five state batches: more than one running at once and never more than three, each in a directory of its own inside dir that holds the model's modules as files, every state checked exactly once, and a driver that tried every step passes.

tests.name: TestTheEarliestBadStepIsReportedWhenALaterBatchFailsFirst
tests.says: With a step the model doesn't allow in the first step batch and another in the third, and the third finishing while the first still runs, Check reports the first batch's step, and doesn't stop the first batch to do it.

tests.name: TestTheEarliestUntriedStepIsReportedWhenALaterBatchFailsFirst
tests.says: With Inc untried in a state of the first state batch and in one of the third, and the third finishing while the first still runs, checkTried reports the first batch's state, and doesn't stop the first batch to do it.
